undertone_results.description: Your skin has yellow, golden, or peach tones that glow best with warm-based shades.

recommendations.foundations: Foundations with golden, yellow, or peach bases
recommendations.concealers: Concealers 1-2 shades lighter with warm undertones to maintain a natural brightness
recommendations.lipsticks: Blushes & Lipsticks in terracotta, coral, apricot, warm nude, or brick red

avoid: Shades labeled cool pink or rosy beige
Ashy contours (opt for warm caramel or bronze instead)

undertone_results.description: Your skin has pink, red, or bluish tones that harmonize best with cooler shades.

recommendations.foundations: Foundations with pink, red, or neutral-cool bases
recommendations.concealers: Concealers 1-2 shades lighter with cool undertones to brighten without turning orange
recommendations.lipsticks: Blushes & Lipsticks in berry, plum, rosy pink, or cool mauve

avoid: Shades labeled golden, yellow, or warm beige

undertone_results.description: Your skin has a balanced mix of warm and cool tones, making it versatile for many shade families.

recommendations.foundations: Foundations labeled neutral or balanced (not overly yellow or pink)
recommendations.concealers: Concealers close to your exact undertone—avoid extremes of too pink or too yellow
recommendations.lipsticks: Blushes & Lipsticks in soft rose, dusty mauve, balanced nude, or muted coral

avoid: Overly pink or blue-based shades that overpower your natural balance
